notes: NovaShell’s local control layer is more useful and easier to read: live system readiness, safer Relay tools, a true pixel-mosaic public game shelf, and refreshed touch-first utility workspaces.
changes: Live system card now shows local OS, controller state, memory, storage, and load before opening deeper activity details.
Relay now explains its local-only provider routes, mirrors the live Project Board, and exposes an explicit-confirmation Local Codex workspace tool.
Utility Desk adds a no-network workspace handoff manifest for folder inventories and SHA-256 fingerprints.
Pocket Archive public captures use a true low-resolution pixel mosaic instead of a blur, while local owners keep their original artwork.
Orbit station names and ON AIR status now use matching readable display plates.
Settings includes Chromebook-aware system and access guidance, with new assets cached for offline PWA use.
